entries.name: Autonomous Circuit
entries.author: Autonomous
entries.description: Describe a board; get a fab-ready PCB with a live board view, ordered from JLCPCB in a click.

entries.name: Autonomous Workshop
entries.author: Autonomous
entries.description: Describe a part; get a validated, printable STEP with a live 3D view.

entries.name: Blender
entries.author: Blender Foundation
entries.description: Describe an object, a scene, a shot — and watch it take shape: modelled in Blender's Python, rendered headless, exported as glTF you can orbit and zoom in the pane.

entries.name: CAD Viewer
entries.author: Jake Fitzgerald
entries.description: Jake Fitzgerald's CAD Viewer (earthtojake/text-to-cad) as a Harness pane: STEP, GLB, STL, 3MF, DXF, URDF, SRDF and SDF, with MoveIt2 inverse kinematics.

entries.name: CircuitJS
entries.author: Paul Falstad
entries.description: Describe a circuit — an RC filter, a 555 flasher, an amplifier — and watch it run in the pane: charge animating along the wires, scope traces drawing, every value still yours to poke at.

entries.name: Doc Viewer
entries.author: Autonomous
entries.description: A reader for the PDF a harness is writing: thumbnails, the outline, find, zoom and two-page spreads on pdf.js — redrawn in place on every compile, changed pages marked, compile errors shown over the last good pages.

entries.name: Excalidraw
entries.author: Excalidraw
entries.description: Describe a diagram — an architecture, a flow, a whiteboard sketch — and watch it appear hand-drawn in the pane, as an .excalidraw file you can open anywhere.

entries.name: Film Viewer
entries.author: OpenHarness contributors
entries.description: A screening room for OpenMontage productions: live storyboards, a film player, render versions, and notes tied to a moment in the cut.

entries.name: Game Viewer
entries.author: OpenHarness contributors
entries.description: A live game studio: playable previews, real build progress, versions, and an uninterrupted last working game while the next one takes shape.

entries.name: Godogen
entries.author: Alex Ermolov
entries.description: Build a world you can play. Watch your game take shape in a live studio, explore each version, and play while the agent keeps creating.

entries.name: Manim
entries.author: Manim Community
entries.description: Describe an explanation — a proof, a transform, an algorithm, a graph — and watch it animate: scenes in Python, rendered by Manim, playing in the pane.

entries.name: marimo
entries.author: marimo
entries.description: Describe an analysis, a model, a dashboard — and watch the reactive notebook come alive in the pane: marimo's own editor on the notebook the agent writes, cells re-running as it types.

entries.name: Marp
entries.author: Yuki Hattori
entries.description: Describe a talk; get a keynote — huge type, generated art, speaker notes — live in the pane, exported to PDF, PPTX or HTML.

entries.name: 3D Viewer
entries.author: Autonomous
entries.description: A Blender-style viewport for the glTF a harness exports — outliner, properties in mm, shading modes, measure, section, explode, scene camera, timeline — live on every export.

entries.name: MuJoCo
entries.author: Google DeepMind
entries.description: Describe a robot, a scene, a controller — a Unitree quadruped standing, a humanoid learning to walk — and watch the rollout play: MuJoCo physics, Menagerie robots, MJX for training.

entries.name: MuJoCo Viewer
entries.author: Autonomous
entries.description: MuJoCo's own simulate, in the pane: live physics you can push, pull and pause, every actuator on a slider, contacts and forces drawn, sensors plotted, and the agent's recording replayed frame by frame — on MuJoCo's WebAssembly build.

entries.name: OpenMontage
entries.author: calesthio
entries.description: Direct a film from the first idea to the final cut. Watch the script, shots, and edits arrive in a live studio; play each version and leave notes right on the film.

entries.name: Phaser
entries.author: Phaser Studio
entries.description: Describe a game — a breakout, a platformer, a shooter, a puzzle — and play it in the pane as the agent writes it in Phaser 4, reloading on every save.

entries.name: RDKit
entries.author: RDKit
entries.description: Describe a molecule — a drug, an analogue, a scaffold — and get it designed, its properties computed and a 3D conformer you can rotate in the pane.

entries.name: Remotion
entries.author: Remotion
entries.description: Describe a video — a product launch, an explainer, a data story — and watch it play in Remotion Studio as the agent writes it in React, then render it to MP4.

entries.name: Strudel
entries.author: Strudel
entries.description: Describe a track — a groove, a bassline, a break — and hear it in the pane. The agent writes one Strudel pattern file; Strudel's own REPL plays it live and hot-swaps on every save.

entries.name: text-to-cad
entries.author: Jake Fitzgerald
entries.description: Jake Fitzgerald's text-to-cad skills (earthtojake/text-to-cad), pinned: describe a part, get STEP with mesh exports, drawings, robot files and G-code, live in the CAD Viewer.

entries.name: Typst
entries.author: Typst GmbH
entries.description: Describe a document — a paper, a spec sheet, a report, a letter — and watch the PDF take shape as Typst compiles it on every save.

entries.name: Video Viewer
entries.author: Autonomous
entries.description: An editor-grade player for what a harness renders: every render listed, chapters on the timeline, frame-accurate scrubbing with a filmstrip, loops and stills — and the render in progress playable as it is made.

entries.name: Web Viewer
entries.author: OpenHarness contributors
entries.description: A live preview for HTML, CSS, and JavaScript in a harness workspace. Reloads when files change.

entries.name: Yosys
entries.author: YosysHQ
entries.description: Describe a digital circuit — a counter, a UART, a state machine — and get Verilog, a simulation with waveforms, a synthesized gate-level schematic and an FPGA bitstream for an iCE40 board. Prompt to silicon.
